versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.1.
- Minor documentation edits in SKILL.md for clarity and consistency.
- No changes to features, functionality, or usage.

Initial release of Deep-Clean Battle Planner

- Plans and schedules deep cleaning sessions by breaking them into optimized cleaning waves based on rooms and available hours.
- Maps cleaning waves onto real weekend time blocks with a built-in 15% buffer to prevent over-scheduling.
- Matches surfaces and soils to recommended cleaners with always-on alerts against dangerous chemical mixes.
- Generates per-room, step-by-step cleaning playbooks with time estimates and specialized upkeep routines.
- Pure Python stdlib; fully offline.
